meta.description: Primary slim resume of Prasad Gade for agent consumption

basics.name: Prasad Gade
basics.label: Data Scientist & Computer Engineer
basics.summary: Data Scientist and Computer Engineer from Mumbai, India. B.Tech student at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (CGPA 9.26/10). Builds data pipelines, ML models, and interactive web applications.

education.institution: Bhartiya Vidya Bhavan's Sardar Patel Institute of Technology
education.minor: Management from SPJIMR (S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research)

highlights: Architected an end-to-end data pipeline using Python to ingest heterogeneous formats (PDF, HTML, XLSX) into reproducible JSON & Markdown with strict evidence provenance
Achieved 91.7% correctness in document extraction via Docling section-aware retrieval, local Ollama inference, and deterministic validation
Engineered a citation-grounded RAG agent using LangGraph, Pydantic, SearXNG, Playwright, & Ollama for query rewriting and quote-level verification with zero pipeline errors
Built automated ETL workflows via Python (Pandas) & PowerShell to process raw institutional data, generating 50+ dynamic PDF reports and actionable KPI dashboards
Typeset a 130-page Ph.D. thesis on Quantum-Inspired Machine Learning using LaTeX & TikZ, managing modular chapter builds and strict version control
Streamlined academic compliance and CO-PO mapping for Outcome-Based Education (OBE) frameworks by developing custom VBA macros for IEEE & IJETT publications
Built Power BI dashboards for business datasets, including an interactive Northwind Traders sales dashboard covering sales, customer, product, and regional trends

projects.name: GraphShield
projects.description: Real-Data Graph ML for Financial Fraud Detection
highlights: Engineered a dual-path spectral GNN evaluated against GraphSAGE on a 3.7M-node, 4.3M-edge DGraphFin dataset using strict leakage-safe splits
Validated robustness via 6-seed real-data ablations achieving 0.7748 AUC-ROC, integrating paired-bootstrap testing, conformal calibration, and temporal drift diagnostics

projects.name: IPL Analytics Platform
highlights: Engineered a 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records from 18 seasons, producing a feature parquet plus 18 aggregate parquet datasets for fast analytics
Built a 15-page Streamlit app backed by 19 DuckDB views, including player, team, venue, matchup, phase, records, tournament, and match-level analysis for 1,169 IPL matches

Implemented a deterministic semantic search engine that compiles supported cricket questions into whitelisted SQL, ships with 40 example prompts, and exposes assumptions plus generated SQL instead of guessing unsupported requests
Added a schema-driven per-visual control system and expanded regression coverage to 52 pytest checks to keep interactive filters and statistics aligned across the analytics pages

projects.name: UPI Analytics Platform
highlights: Processed 9,026 JSON files via a 4-stage medallion pipeline into a DuckDB star schema, deploying 68 visualizations on Streamlit & Power BI with GitHub Actions CI/CD
Quantified market duopoly via HHI & Gini coefficients, segmented adoption with K-Means, and forecasted transaction volumes using Prophet & ARIMA

projects.name: Lex Simulacra
highlights: Architected an 8-agent courtroom simulator using LangGraph with stateful multi-turn debate, served via a real-time Streamlit UI and FastAPI SSE
Built a citation-grounded RAG pipeline over 100K+ legal documents using ChromaDB & BM25, boosting context relevance by 3.2x via hallucination checks and context compression

projects.name: Intrusion Detection
highlights: Benchmarked 6 ML/DL models on the 8.6M-sample TII-SSRC-23 dataset, achieving 99.99% accuracy, 99.99% precision, and 100% recall
Showed the Decision Tree trained 12.8x faster with 20x higher inference throughput and full SHAP interpretability

projects.name: KindHearts
highlights: Built the platform that won 1st place at Tech Horizon National Hackathon
Improved donation workflow speed and transparency with real-time tracking

projects.name: Celestial Classifier
highlights: Achieved 99.07% accuracy (0.99 F1) classifying 10,000 celestial objects into stars, galaxies, and quasars
Improved neural-network accuracy from 95.13% to 98.78% using Keras Tuner across 10 trials
Benchmarked 4 classifiers on 3,000 test samples via 5-fold cross-validation and 960+ fits

projects.name: NutriSnap
highlights: Used Gemini API for image and manual nutrition tracking
Implemented dashboard-based calorie and macro tracking

projects.name: Audio Visualizer
highlights: Built a client-side music visualizer with multiple display modes
Deployed it as a live GitHub Pages app

projects.name: Attendance Tracker
highlights: Built attendance reports, analysis views, and editable records
Added offline-first storage with import and export support

projects.name: Habit Tracker
highlights: Created streaks, calendar views, analytics, and contribution-style charts
Kept the app privacy-first with offline local storage

projects.name: Portfolio
highlights: Built a multi-theme interactive portfolio with a Minecraft skin viewer
Added paper physics, hidden easter eggs, and agent-readable static APIs
